desc: Sets who a Slackbot skill is automatically turned on for.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

usergroup_ids.desc: One to 100 user groups for named_entities. Duplicates count toward the input limit and are stored once. Omit for other permission types.

permission_type.desc: Who receives a skill automatically. This setting does not grant access to its instructions.

feature_not_enabled.desc: The Skills API is not enabled for this organization.

not_an_enterprise.desc: This method requires an Enterprise Grid organization.

restricted_action.desc: The caller must be an org admin or owner with permission to manage skills.

internal_error.desc: The operation could not be completed. Retry the request.

skill_not_found.desc: The skill is missing, deleted, no longer a skill, or outside this organization.

method_not_supported_for_skill_type.desc: Only canvas skills can be deployed.

skill_not_visible_to_audience.desc: Share the skill first. usergroup_ids lists the groups that cannot view it.

audience_too_large.desc: Validating this audience requires more than 1,000 member checks across the requested groups. Overlapping members count once per group. Select a smaller audience, or share the canvas org-wide if that access is intended, before retrying.

named_entities_cannot_be_empty.desc: Provide at least one user group for named_entities.

usergroup_not_found.desc: invalid_usergroup_ids lists missing, deleted or foreign user groups.
